sections.text:

|--------|------|-------------|
| [GET](#get-all-nodes-stats-last) | `/v1/nodes/stats/last` | Get latest stats for all nodes |
| [GET](#get-node-stats-last) | `/v1/nodes/stats/last/{uid}` | Get latest stats for a single node |

sections.title: Get latest stats for all nodes
sections.text:
[code example]

Get latest statistics for all nodes.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_all_nodes_stats](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_all_nodes_stats) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

[code example]


#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |


#### Query parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| interval | string | Time interval for which we want stats: 1sec/10sec/5min/15min/1hour/12hour/1week. Default: 1sec. (optional) |
| stime | ISO_8601 | Start time from which we want the stats. Should comply with the [ISO_8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format (optional) |
| etime | ISO_8601 | End time after which we don't want the stats. Should comply with the [ISO_8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format (optional) |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns most recent [statistics](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/statistics) for all nodes.

[code example]

sections.title: Status codes
sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [200 OK](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.2.1) | No error |
| [404 Not Found](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.5) | No nodes exist |

sections.title: Get latest node stats
sections.text:
[code example]

Get the latest statistics of a node.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_node_stats](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_node_stats) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

[code example]


#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |


#### URL parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| uid | integer | The unique ID of the node requested. |


#### Query parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| interval | string | Time interval for which we want stats: 1sec/10sec/5min/15min/1hour/12hour/1week. Default: 1sec. (optional) |
| stime | ISO_8601 | Start time from which we want the stats. Should comply with the [ISO_8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)format (optional) |
| etime | ISO_8601 | End time after which we don't want the stats. Should comply with the [ISO_8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)format (optional) |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns the most recent [statistics](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/statistics) for the specified node.

#### Example JSON body

[code example]

sections.title: Error codes
sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [200 OK](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.2.1) | No error |
| [404 Not Found](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.5) | Node does not exist |
| [406 Not Acceptable](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.7) | Node isn't currently active |
| [503 Service Unavailable](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.5.4) | Mode is in recovery state |
